text:
:= by
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  rw [Finset.cons_eq_insert]
  exact h _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 ⟨ha, rfl⟩)
· intro h'
  constructor
  · intros s t hst
    apply h'
    intro a ha
    by_cases h : a ∈ s
    · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.2 h))
    · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.1 h))
  · intros s t hst
    apply h'
    intro a ha
    by_cases h : a ∈ s
    · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.2 h))
    · exact h' _ (Finset.insert_subset.2 (Finset.subset.1 h))
